lines.beaver_en: Did you look for a place to stay? It's peak season, so I'm worried.
lines.learner: 네, 성수기라 호텔 객실은 다 찼어요.
lines.en: Yes, it's peak season, so the hotel rooms are all booked.
lines.roman: Ne, seongsugira hotel gaeksireun da chasseoyo.

lines.learner: 네, 값에 놀란 나머지 바로 포기했어요.
lines.en: Yes, I was so shocked by the prices that I gave up right away.
lines.roman: Ne, gapse nollan nameoji baro pogihaesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 어디서 자요? 다른 방법이 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Then where will we sleep? Is there another option?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom eodiseo jayo? Dareun bangbeobi isseoyo?
lines.learner: 현지 민박을 찾아봤어요. 아직 방이 있대요.
lines.en: I looked for a local guesthouse. They say rooms are still available.
lines.roman: Hyeonji minbageul chajabwasseoyo. Ajik bangi itdaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: A guesthouse? How did you find it?
lines.en: I saw it in a travelogue. The reviews were good.

lines.learner: 글쓴이가 거기서 한 달을 살다시피 했대요.
lines.en: The writer practically lived there for a month.
lines.roman: Geulsseuniga geogiseo han dareul saldasipi haetdaeyo.

lines.beaver: 와, 정말 좋았나 봐요. 방은 깨끗하대요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, it must have been really good. Are the rooms clean?
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, jeongmal joanna bwayo. Bangeun kkaekkeutadaeyo?
lines.learner: 네, 객실이 넓고 깨끗해서 인기가 있을 법해요.
lines.en: Yes, the rooms are big and clean, so it makes sense it's popular.
lines.roman: Ne, gaeksiri neolkko kkaekkeutaeseo ingiga isseul beopaeyo.

lines.beaver: 잘됐네요. 근처에 살 만한 게 있을까요?
lines.beaver_en: Great. Is there anything worth buying nearby?
lines.beaver_roman: Jaldwaenneyo. Geuncheoe sal manhan ge isseulkkayo?
lines.learner: 시장에 특산물이 많대요. 선물로 사도 좋겠어요.
lines.en: They say the market has lots of local specialties. Good for gifts.
lines.roman: Sijange teuksanmuri mandaeyo. Seonmullo sado jokesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. By the way, will you stop by the duty-free shop too?
lines.en: Yes, I'll just stop by the airport duty-free shop briefly.

lines.beaver_en: Then should we book the guesthouse right now?
lines.learner: 네, 금방 찰 것 같아요. 지금 할게요.
lines.en: Yes, it looks like it'll fill up soon. I'll do it now.
lines.roman: Ne, geumbang chal geot gatayo. Jigeum halgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. Because of you, I'm looking forward to the trip.
lines.en: Me too. I'll message you right after I book.
